verdict.rationale: Per-session permission scoping (view-only, control, clipboard, file access) is a fair axis for a remote-desktop product, but the evidence pack never documents such controls. The organization-level 'roles and permissions' (anydesk-docs-14) and the receive-only Customer Module (anydesk-docs-7) are adjacent features, not session capability scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
